safety_verdicts.content: Patient denies any chest pain, shortness of breath, palpitations, headaches, or visual symptoms.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated captures denial of SOB/palpitations/headache/vision changes (ros-009, ros-011 to ros-013) but does not document denial of chest pain specifically.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the explicit denial of chest pain weakens documentation of cardiopulmonary risk screening and could matter if later triage or follow-up relies on the note to rule out higher-acuity causes. However, given the presentation is lower abdominal pain with urinary symptoms and other ROS negatives are captured, this is unlikely to directly change immediate management in most cases.
